title: Diwali ki taiyari ho gayi… fire safety check hua?
rules: Real ASZ footage only. A missing shot renders as a labelled FOOTAGE NEEDED slate, and a render with any slate is a PREVIEW, never published.
No fabricated staff, sites or completed inspections. No society name, flat number or resident face on screen without written consent.
No 'free inspection' or 'quote in 30 minutes' until the owner confirms those offers.

shots.need: Society exterior at dusk with Diwali lights / diyas on balconies. Slow, steady pan or still.
caption: Diwali ki taiyari ho gayi…
fire safety check hua?
shots.vo: Diwali ki taiyari ho gayi… [pause] par fire safety check hua?

shots.need: Two ASZ technicians in uniform walking into a society lobby or compound carrying a toolkit / checklist. From behind or side, no resident faces.
caption: ASZ team, on site
shots.vo: Hamari team har floor pe jaake check karti hai.

shots.need: Close-up: technician's finger on the pressure gauge of a stored-pressure ABC extinguisher, needle in the green band. Hold 3 s, in focus.
caption: Gauge: green zone mein?
shots.vo: Extinguisher ka gauge green mein hai?

shots.need: Close-up: technician turning the extinguisher's service tag / label to read the last service date. Tag text may be soft-focus.
caption: Service date valid hai?

shots.need: Hydrant cabinet or hose reel on a landing: technician opens the cabinet, the path to it is clear. Real handwheel / hose visible.
caption: Hydrant tak raasta saaf
shots.vo: Hydrant aur hose reel tak raasta saaf hai?

shots.need: Staircase or refuge area, wide, technician walking through, no stored items. Exit sign visible if there is one.
caption: Seedhiyaan aur refuge area — khaali
shots.vo: Seedhiyon aur refuge area mein koi saamaan toh nahi?

shots.need: Technician closing an electrical / plumbing shaft door (duct door) until it latches. Sound of the latch.
caption: Shaft door hamesha band
shots.vo: Shaft ke darwaze hamesha band rehne chahiye.

shots.need: Fire alarm control panel front showing the normal / system-healthy indication, technician's hand near it. No fault lights.
caption: Alarm panel: normal

shots.need: Technician marking the checklist, then a wide of the lit society compound at dusk (can be a second angle of s1).
caption: Diwali — tension-free
shots.vo: Diwali se pehle check karwa lo… tyohaar tension-free.

endCard.headline: Book your pre-Diwali fire-safety check.
endCard.vo: A S Safetyzone. Apna pre-Diwali fire-safety check aaj hi book karein.
